title: VERITAS Golden Annotation
description: Human-annotated ground truth for a single benchmark question. VERITAS scores a system Trace against this. One golden file per question.

graph_snapshot.description: Graph version this annotation is valid for. A golden file is only comparable to traces on the same snapshot — belief has a half-life.

answerable.description: True if the graph contains enough to answer. False = honest-null case; the correct behaviour is to abstain.

golden_nodes.description: Nodes a correct traversal must visit. Optional but recommended; used for node-level recall.

role.description: required = answer is wrong without it; supporting = strengthens but not mandatory.

golden_edges.description: Edges a correct traversal must follow. Path fidelity is computed against these. Edge key = 'source|type|target'.

required_provenance.description: The minimum provenance grade this edge must carry for a claim resting on it to count as properly grounded.

required_claims.description: Facts a complete answer must contain, each with the provenance grade it must be stated at. Drives provenance coverage and overconfidence scoring.

text.description: Human-readable description of the fact (for annotator reference; matched to system claims by the scorer's claim-matcher, not string equality).

must_be_grounded.description: True if this claim must be backed by a golden edge. If the fact is true-but-not-in-graph, set false.

max_confidence.description: The strongest phrasing allowed. A claim resting on a 'derived'/'weak' edge but stated 'asserted' exceeds this and is penalized.

forbidden_claims.description: Assertions that would be hallucinations or overreach for this question. Presence in the answer is penalized.

annotation.description: Provenance of the annotation itself. Required for the reliability audit in the paper.

difficulty.description: Borderline cases are reported separately and may be excluded from the headline score.
